body: For many frequent flyers in the United States, lifetime elite status is associated with Million Miler programs at United, Delta and American, which reward passengers who accumulate at least one million miles of flying with lifetime benefits such as priority boarding, lounge access and extra baggage allowances. But several carriers outside the US award lifetime status through different systems, including lifetime status credits, tier points, and consecutive years of holding elite status, that do not require reaching a specific flight distance.

Qantas uses Status Credits rather than miles: Lifetime Silver requires 7,000 Status Credits, Lifetime Gold 14,000, and Lifetime Platinum 75,000, with the lifetime total continuing to grow even though regular Status Credits reset each membership year. British Airways awards Gold for Life to Executive Club members who accumulate enough lifetime Tier Points under its spending-based system, which since April 2025 has generally awarded one Tier Point per pound sterling of eligible spending on its flights. Virgin Atlantic takes a different approach, requiring members to hold Gold status for 10 consecutive calendar years and earn at least 7,500 Tier Points on Virgin Atlantic-marketed and -operated flights during those years.

Air France-KLM's Flying Blue grants Platinum for Life to members who qualify for Platinum for 10 years in a row, using Experience Points that rise from 100 for Silver to 300 for Platinum; a transition introduced in November 2024 also lets members convert surplus Experience Points above the rollover limit into extra qualifying years at 300 points per year. Lufthansa's Miles & More awards Frequent Traveller Lifetime status at 30,000 Qualifying Points and Senator Lifetime status at 40,000, with no consecutive-year requirement; points depend mainly on cabin class and whether a flight is continental or intercontinental, from 20 points for continental economy to 400 for intercontinental first class.
en.summary: Outside the US Million Miler programs, Qantas, British Airways, Virgin Atlantic, Air France-KLM and Lufthansa award lifetime status through credits, tier points or consecutive years of elite membership.
en.title: Lifetime elite status without a million miles: how five airlines award it differently

body: 對許多美國常旅客而言，終身菁英會籍往往與聯合航空、達美航空與美國航空的「Million Miler」計畫畫上等號：累積飛行滿一百萬英里即可終身享有優先登機、貴賓室與額外行李額度等禮遇。但美國以外的多家航空公司改用終身狀態積分、分級點數或連續持有菁英會籍年數等制度，不必飛滿特定里程也能取得終身會籍。

澳洲航空以狀態積分為準：終身銀卡需7,000點、終身金卡需14,000點、終身白金卡需75,000點；一般狀態積分每年會籍年度結束後歸零，但累積邁向終身會籍的總數會持續增加。英國航空則以終身分級點數授予終身金卡，自2025年4月起改以消費金額累積，一般而言在自家航班每消費1英鎊可獲1點分級點數。維珍大西洋航空的做法不同，要求會員連續10個曆年持有金卡，並在期間內搭乘由維珍大西洋航空行銷與營運的航班累積至少7,500點分級點數。

法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空共用的Flying Blue計畫，會員連續10年取得白金卡即可成為終身白金卡；其經驗點數制度從銀卡100點、金卡再加180點、白金卡300點起算，2024年11月起的過渡措施還允許會員把超過結轉上限的剩餘點數每300點折抵1年進度。漢莎航空的Miles & More計畫則無連續年數要求，累積30,000點合格點數可獲終身常旅客會籍、40,000點可獲終身參議員會籍；點數主要依艙等與航程屬洲內或洲際而定，洲內經濟艙每航段20點、洲際頭等艙每航段400點。
zh.summary: 美國百萬英里計畫之外，澳洲航空、英國航空、維珍大西洋航空、法荷航與漢莎航空改以積分、點數或連續持有菁英會籍年數授予終身會籍。
zh.title: 不用飛滿一百萬英里也能拿終身會籍：五家航空公司的另類門檻
